title: Scan Letters Only

content.problemStatement: Scan a string that accepts letters only. (Both uppercase and lowercase letters)

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input 'Hello123' produces expected output '' following problem rules.

solution.approach: Scan characters from the string and stop when a non-letter character is encountered.
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Iterate through the string and break upon encountering the first character that is not an alphabet letter.

hints: Accept both uppercase ('A'-'Z') and lowercase ('a'-'z') letters.
Stop at digits, punctuation, or spaces.
Use isalpha() or character range checks.
learningObjectives: Extract prefixes meeting specific character predicates.
